pin_title: 7 Cosy Home Buys UK Homes Swear By This Autumn
pin_hook: Snuggle-up staples with genuinely great reviews
pin_description: Cosy home essentials from Amazon UK: a heated throw, a fleece sofa blanket, sherpa slipper boots, a fleece-covered hot water bottle, a Yankee Candle jar, warm white fairy lights and corduroy cushion covers. Autumn and winter home ideas for a snug living room and bedroom. #ad #cosyhome #autumnhome #hygge #ukhome
intro: As the evenings draw in, here are seven well-reviewed buys that make it easy to turn any room into a proper snug spot.

products.name: Silentnight Luxury Super Cosy Heated Throw, Chunky Knit Jacquard Fleece Electric Blanket, 120x160cm, Charcoal
products.headline: A sofa blanket that heats itself up
products.why: A chunky-knit fleece throw with 9 heat settings and a fast heat-up time, so movie night doesn't need the central heating cranked up.

products.name: Bedsure Fleece Throw Blanket for Sofa, Fluffy Cosy Warm Blanket, Off White, 130x170cm
products.headline: The blanket that lives permanently on the sofa
products.why: A soft, lightweight fleece throw that's big enough to share and just as easy to wash as it is to snuggle under.

products.name: LongBay Women's Slipper Boots, Warm Memory Foam Indoor Outdoor House Shoes
products.headline: Keep cold feet out of the equation
products.why: Fleece-lined boot slippers with a memory foam sole, warm enough for indoors but sturdy enough for a quick trip to the bin.

products.name: CityComfort Hot Water Bottle with Soft Fleece Cover, Natural Rubber, 2 Litre
products.headline: An old-school way to warm up a cold bed
products.why: A generous 2-litre rubber bottle with a genuinely soft fleece cover, one of the simplest ways to take the chill off an evening.

products.name: Yankee Candle Scented Candle, Black Cherry, Large Jar, Up to 150 Hours Burn Time
products.headline: The candle that makes a room feel done
products.why: A long-burning, richly scented jar candle that's one of Amazon UK's most-reviewed home fragrances for a reason.

products.name: Lights4fun Indoor Fairy Lights, 200 Warm White LEDs, 16m Clear Cable with Plug
products.headline: Soft lighting that beats a bright overhead bulb
products.why: A long run of warm white LEDs on a mains plug, an easy way to add gentle light to a shelf, mirror or mantelpiece.

products.name: MIULEE Corduroy Cushion Covers, 50 x 50cm, Pack of 4, Dark Grey
products.headline: An instant sofa refresh for autumn
products.why: Soft ribbed corduroy covers that swap a sofa's look in minutes and machine wash easily when they need a refresh.
